title: Amiodarone — Pediatric VF / Pulseless VT

changelog.change: Reverted to the standard PALS dose (5 mg/kg, max 300 mg for ALL doses, repeat up to 2×). The build-package draft's '150 mg subsequent cap' could not be confirmed against current sources and would underdose a repeat in a child ≥ 30 kg — removed.

purpose: Shock-refractory VF / pulseless VT during pediatric cardiac arrest.

rule.repeat: May repeat 5 mg/kg up to 2 more times (3 doses total) for refractory VF/pVT

doses.notes: Rapid bolus in arrest (unlike the slow infusion used for a perfusing rhythm). Lidocaine 1 mg/kg IV/IO is the accepted alternative.

buildNote: Standard PALS: 5 mg/kg, max single dose 300 mg, may repeat twice. If the maintainer has the actual 2025 PALS PDF and it specifies a different subsequent-dose cap, add it back as a second `doses` row (that's how a per-attempt difference is encoded — the engine has no attempt counter).
